answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation-based Sybil resistance mechanism, where agents are assigned a unique identity tied to a scarce resource, such as a jade token. As agents participate in the network, they earn reputation scores based on their contributions, which are verified through a karst topology of interconnected nodes. An attacker attempting to create fake identities would need to expend significant computational resources, akin to trying to summon a zephyr through brute force, making it economically infeasible to launch a successful Sybil attack.
